apply_layerwise_casting: apply layerwise casting to a diffusers module with storage and compute dtypes to reduce memory footprint
apply_layerwise_casting_hook: apply a layerwise casting hook to a module for per-forward dtype conversion between storage and compute precision
create_LayerwiseCastingHook: create a LayerwiseCastingHook that casts module weights to compute dtype before forward and storage dtype after forward
create_PeftInputAutocastDisableHook: create a PeftInputAutocastDisableHook to prevent PEFT from casting inputs to lower precision weight dtypes
test__is_layerwise_casting_active: test whether layerwise casting is active on a module by checking for registered casting hooks
